{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Verify the conversion
print("Data type after cleaning:", sales['revenue_clean'].dtype)
print("First few cleaned revenue values:", sales['revenue_clean'].head().tolist())

# Check for the QA orders with revenue 999999.99
print("Rows with revenue 999999.99:", sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]['order_id'].tolist())

# Confirm the count of such rows
print("Number of QA orders:", len(sales[sales['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99]))"}
